verbs.name: export.srt
verbs.description: Export captions as .srt — the ONLY SRT exporter (captions.export_srt dropped). Default path <project>/exports/captions.srt; an explicit FENCED path must end in .srt.

verbs.name: export.vtt
verbs.description: Export the caption track to WebVTT (HTML5 <track> standard for web-published video). Default <project>/exports/captions.vtt; an explicit FENCED path must end in .vtt.

verbs.name: export.ass
verbs.description: Export the caption track to ASS/SSA — the PORTABLE styled-caption standard (SRT/VTT carry no styling; ASS keeps font/size/colour/position and is what ffmpeg burns via libass). karaoke:false (default) writes one styled Dialogue per caption line. karaoke:true writes WORD-LEVEL `\k` fill (the TikTok/Hormozi look): each line's words highlight in turn, timed across the clip, with a dim SecondaryColour so the fill is visible (word timing is estimated from the line duration, proportional to word length). Default <project>/exports/captions.ass; an explicit FENCED path must end in .ass. Round-trips with captions.import (which parses .ass back to plain caption lines).

karaoke.description: Emit word-level \k karaoke fill instead of line-level styled captions (default false).

verbs.name: export.transcript
verbs.description: Write the caption track as a readable transcript — the script of the FINAL cut (timeline-accurate; reflects what survived the cut, not the raw recording) — for show notes, blog repurposing, or an accessibility transcript page. Cues join into paragraphs, a new paragraph after a natural >2s pause. format txt (plain paragraphs) | md (heading + paragraphs, [m:ss]-prefixed when timestamps:true). Requires captions.generate first.

timestamps.description: md only: prefix each paragraph with [m:ss] (default false).

path.description: Output file; default <project>/exports/transcript.<ext>. An explicit FENCED path must match format (.txt or .md).

verbs.name: export.chapters
verbs.description: Write the timeline markers as a time-sorted chapter list ("M:SS Label" / "H:MM:SS Label" lines) for YouTube/podcast chapters. Default <project>/exports/chapters.txt; an explicit FENCED path must end in .txt. first_at_zero flags whether chapter 1 is at 0:00 (YouTube requires it).
